title: A Systematic Evaluation of Generative Models on Tabular Transportation Data
summary: Research code accompanying a PAKDD 2025 paper that benchmarks generative models (GAN-, VAE-, copula- and diffusion-based) for synthesizing tabular taxi-trip transportation data. The repository vendors and modifies the SDV and CTGAN source trees in-tree, then drives them through sdv.single_table's CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer, GaussianCopulaSynthesizer and CopulaGANSynthesizer (plus a custom ZoneStatSynthesizer) as several of the compared generators, with sdmetrics' QualityReport used for evaluation.
evidence: tab_main.py:11 imports CTGANSynthesizer/TVAESynthesizer/GaussianCopulaSynthesizer/CopulaGANSynthesizer; used in dispatcher dict at line 42 to run methods
